Bug_Title: SING: Instance-getter method of class using singleton design pattern is not synchronized. (SING_SINGLETON_GETTER_NOT_SYNCHRONIZED)
Bug_Details:
Instance-getter method of class using singleton design pattern is not synchronized. When this method is invoked by two or more threads simultaneously,
multiple instantiation of a singleton class becomes possible.
SEI CERT MSC07-J rule
Bug_Explanation: The getInstance method of the SingletonExample class is not synchronized. This could lead to multiple threads creating multiple instances of the SingletonExample class when they access the instance variable simultaneously, violating the singleton pattern.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug() method, which starts two threads accessing the getInstance() method concurrently. This triggers the bug by potentially creating two different instances of SingletonExample due to the lack of synchronization.
